subject: C-suite keeper roles & final meeting schedule for close
messages:
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@heliosfin.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Carl Bennett <c.bennett@heliosfin.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 11:23:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + next steps to close — exec alignment & MAP

Markus — thanks for the demo last week. Helios is aligned on product fit and procurement has flagged two final asks before we can greenlight a purchase order: executive sponsor alignment and a mutually agreed close plan that maps technical eval gates to procurement milestones.

High level asks from our side: 
- Confirm who on Redwood will own executive briefings (we expect a single exec owner + a secondary backup).
- A one-page Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that ties the POC acceptance criteria to procurement steps and legal review windows.
- A suggested Executive Board (EB) meeting date in the week of Dec 20–24 to finalize budget approval.

Carl (cc) will be the internal exec for sign-off on our side — he'll lead the EB meeting. Our target closing window is last week of December if we can get the MAP and EB scheduled this week.

Attached: procurement_timeline.xlsx (current internal milestones).

Availability: Carl and I are free Dec 22 morning PT or Dec 23 afternoon PT.

Appreciate a short plan + owners.

—Sarah
Sarah Li
VP, Product
Helios Financial

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@heliosfin.com>
Cc: Carl Bennett <c.bennett@heliosfin.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 13:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + next steps to close — exec alignment & MAP

Sarah — thanks for the clear asks and the timeline. We can meet the cadence. Quick answers up front: 
- Executive owner: I will be the Redwood exec convener for the EB; Marissa Cole will be the executive backup and will run the briefing materials.
- MAP: Karthik will draft a one-page MAP that maps your POC acceptance criteria to procurement/legal milestones and proposed dates.
- EB meeting: proposing Dec 22, 10:00–11:00 PT (we'll send a calendar invite once you confirm).

Karthik/Marissa — can you take the items below and assemble the MAP + meeting slide deck by EOD Dec 15? I will own the EB invite and the exec briefing narrative.

Action items (internal):
- Karthik: draft MAP_v1.pdf, include acceptance criteria and required deliverables from Helios.
- Marissa: prepare 3-slide exec brief: value + risk surface + ask.
- Legal/Procure (we'll loop later): include any standard SLAs and data handling notes.

Sarah — once you confirm the Dec 22 slot we'll lock it.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0172

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 16:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + next steps to close — exec alignment & MAP

Markus — noted. Karthik and I met briefly and sketched the MAP and timeline. Sharing draft milestones here so you can comment before I put together the slide deck.

Draft MAP milestones (initial pass):
1) 12/15 — MAP_v1 internal draft completed (Karthik).
2) 12/16 — MAP review with Helios (45 min remote) — review acceptance criteria and procurement dependencies.
3) 12/18 — Final MAP and commercial terms drafted for legal review.
4) 12/22 — Executive Board briefing and sign-off (target).
5) 12/23–12/29 — PO issuance & procurement close window.

Open questions for Markus: do we want to include a short fallback policy if the EB needs to be postponed (e.g., auto-commit to an expedited Exec async sign-off + 48h Docusign window)? I suggest yes given the year-end timing.

Karthik — can you paste the acceptance criteria bullets you'll include? I want those in the deck intro.

Thanks — I'll start the slide shell and pull the summary from MAP_v1.

—Marissa

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + next steps to close — exec alignment & MAP

Adding acceptance criteria (will be in MAP_v1.pdf):
- End-to-end latency for our 95th percentile production inference at target load <= 350ms using the reserved instance configuration.
- Embedding recall > 0.88 on the Helios eval set (50 queries/sample).
- KV cache integration validated in the POC environment with no data exfiltration flags.
- Stability: sustained 72-hour soak with error rate < 0.5%.

I'll attach MAP_v1.pdf to Markus' outgoing. Including the fallback clause Marissa suggested: if EB is postponed, Redwood exec will approve an expedited async review + 48-hour DocuSign window.

Karthik
